## Flagship Systems & Projects
- Autonomous Self-Healing CI/CD: AI agent with Gemini Pro & LangChain diagnosing build failures, auto-remediating issues, and driving Next.js real-time status. Auto-triages 80%+ of common pipeline errors, 94.2% downtime reduction, MTTR under 2 minutes.
- Cloud Inventory Assistant (AWS MCP Server): Engineered an Anthropic Model Context Protocol server that answers natural-language inventory questions across 15+ AWS accounts, with secure cross-account read-only IAM roles for auditing, plus a CLI integration for infrastructure teams. Resource discovery 90% faster, 100+ misconfigurations flagged.
- AI SRE Command Center: AWS CloudWatch + Lambda + SSM integration with automated LLM root cause analysis. CloudWatch alarms trigger Lambda handlers, SSM diagnostics, Gemini-suggested fixes, real-time WebSocket dashboard. MTTR under 3 minutes.
